CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistStoryTe:
Once upon a time,
there was a little

boy who was given
a new BICYCLE…

He wanted to try
it right away…

He was having so
much fun that he

didn't notice the
sun had set…

While riding home
in the pitch-black

night, the bike
suddenly slowed!

The pedals became
heavy!

When he stopped
pedaling, the bike

began slipping
backwards!

It was as if the
bike were cursed

and trying to drag
him into oblivion!

…

…

SHRIEEEEK!

The boy had been
riding uphill on CYCLING ROAD!

…
Ba-dum ba-dum!

For listening so
patiently, you may take this--TM03!
CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistCurseTe:
TM03 is CURSE.

It's a terrifying
move that slowly

whittles down the
victim's HP.
